responsibility: Contains the FR30 RTL machine description that maps generic GCC operations onto FR30 instructions. It defines instruction patterns, attributes such as length and delay-slot behavior, branches, calls, jumps, moves, and prologue/epilogue expanders, and ties these patterns to target predicates, constraints, and helper routines from fr30.cc so reload, scheduling, and final emission can generate correct FR30 assembly.
same_name_distinction: Holds the FR30 RTL machine description: declarative define_insn/define_expand patterns, attributes, delay-slot rules, and instruction selection for generated assembly, including calls into helper routines in fr30.cc, rather than the macro-level target configuration in the header or the user-facing target option table in the .opt file.
